quote: It's such a simple idea, but it makes a huge difference. Instead of scrolling through random content, I'm spending more time with God's Word.
Honestly, this is the first Bible app I've been able to stick with. It makes reading Scripture feel so simple and natural.
I used to spend so much time mindlessly scrolling. Now I actually look forward to opening my phone and reading a few Bible verses.
I love how easy it is to discover new verses. Sometimes I come across exactly what I needed to hear that day.
